title: Nike and the NFL Introduce Next Chapter of Rivalries With 2026 Uniform Reveal
summary: Building on the success of the Nike x NFL Rivalries first-year launch, Nike and the National Football League are unveiling the 2026 Rivalries uniforms alongside the coinciding fan apparel manufactured and sold by Fanatics.
